name: Living-Graph Linking Audit
description: Audit a project's link quality: uncapped neighborhood linking metrics, placeholder detection, and orphaned-duplicate discovery.

steps.description: Collect link-quality metrics for the project's graph linking on fresh signals: candidates, qualified, edges, duration. Hands on link_metrics. The numbers must come from real tool results the walk shows; if none are available say so rather than estimating.
steps.name: collect_metrics

steps.description: Check that no persisted edge or child is a placeholder echo (content-depth rules). Hands on a clean-content verdict with the offending items.
steps.name: reject_placeholders

steps.description: Scan the project subtree for duplicate names, resolve canonical by min id and report the scatter. Hands on a duplicate report.
steps.name: find_duplicates
